title: Choccy
description: Adds chockolate milk and milk cauldruns
body:
Create delicious chocolate milk out of cocoa beans!

Choccy adds chocolate milk, a new drink that resrotes hunger points and retains milk's property of clearing all status effects when you drink it. Chocolate milk comes in two flavours: buckets and bottles you can craft in cauldrons.

<details>
  <summary>Recipes</summary>

  ![Chocolate Milk Buckets can be crafted with four Cocoal Beans and a Milk Bucket.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/167e9278898471a0366fbe7c3434f16d02300b35.png)
  
  ![Cocoa Powder can be crafted with four Cocoa Beans.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a40f9fc3916eb6b68542a3fb3638a06dd63aed4.png)
  
  ![Chocolate Milk can be crafted with Cocoa Powder and a Milk Bucket.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8657e51484af35f3fe528cf29726be4384908698.png)
  
  ![If you really want to, you can craft Cookies with Cocoa Powder instead of Cocoa Beans.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fe59704cd14f8a1c79738929d0fb58660a7eb86.png)

  You can also combine Milk and Cocoa Powder in a bucket to get Chocolate Milk.
</details>

# Data packs
Choccy introduces a new item tag: `#choccy:chocolate_milk_dry_ingredients`. It determines what you can add to milk to craft Chocolate Milk. By default, it only contains Cocoa Powder.

# Modpacks
You're free to include Choccy in your modpacks, just note that I probably won't release updates.
